row.name: Dealer branch · Abu Dhabi
row.val: Al Masaood Power Division (Al Masaood LLC)
row.note: UAE distributor of Volvo Penta engines since 1972, per Al Masaood's own press release. The division also carries mtu and Leroy-Somer, and states a power generation range from almost 70 kVA to almost 4,000 kVA across its brands (UAE and Bahrain). Volvo Penta's dealer locator was not checked.

add.name: Importer and genset assembly · Riyadh
add.val: Alkhorayef Group (Alkhorayef Industries, Gulf Power gensets)
add.note: Alkhorayef is Volvo Penta's importer in Saudi Arabia (more than 45,000 heavy diesel engines delivered over three decades, per Volvo Group). Its Gulf Power gensets use Volvo Penta and John Deere engines with Stamford alternators, assembled at its Riyadh plant. The sources are dated 2001 to 2014; the current arrangement was not confirmed.
